caption:
Every service business runs four systems.

Acquisition. Conversion. Operations. Retention.

One of them is usually the broken one, and it drains the other three.

Score each system 1 to 4 on your own business right now:

01 Acquisition - booked appointments, or just clicks?
02 Conversion - how fast does a new lead hear back, day or night?
03 Operations - does your team know the next move on every open lead?
04 Retention - do past customers ever hear from you again?

Add the four numbers.

4-8 means one system is bleeding you dry. 9-13 means the leaks are compounding. 14-16 means you're running tight, protect it.

Found your weak system?
